speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with a breast mass; to begin my evaluation, how long have you noticed this lump, and has it changed in size recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rapidly growing breast mass in a 48-year-old female is highly suspicious for an inflammatory breast cancer or a high-grade malignancy such as a phyllodes tumor. I need to immediately order an ultrasound and a mammogram to characterize the mass, followed by a biopsy.
